> 第十二章 白骨真经（第1页）
雨声未歇，檐下滴水如断线珍珠，敲在青石阶上，碎成一片空寂。
玄机老人指尖轻叩桌面，那声响极轻，却仿佛敲在上官复的心上。老人浑浊的眼珠里映着烛光，幽幽说道：“东方前辈晚年皈依佛门，常于关门山惠泉寺参禅。他将那招‘绝代一剑’的剑意，托付给了当时的住持宏海禅师。自此，这一剑便不再是杀伐之术，而成了一段禅机，由惠泉寺历代住持守护，秘不外传。”
他顿了顿，目光如古井无波：“传到这一代，惠泉寺的主持，便是苦禅大师。”
“苦禅大师……”上官复心头猛地一跳，如遭雷击。这个名字像一把生锈的钥匙，猝然捅开了记忆深处某扇尘封的暗门。他脑海中瞬间闪过一个人影——那个总是沉默地扫洒庭院、偶尔在长乐帮总坛外化缘的苦行僧。他一直以为那只是个寻常游方僧人，未曾想，竟是守护着两百年前噩梦的守剑人！
玄机老人将上官复的失态尽收眼底，却不再多言，只缓缓起身，宽大的袍袖拂过桌面：“老朽言尽于此，其余种种，上官帮主自有通天彻地之能，想必能推演一二。”
上官复亦站起身，抱拳沉声道：“多谢老先生今日指点迷津。至此，你我当年之约，算是圆满了结。”他话语中透着一丝不易察觉的怅惘，“只是此番一别，江湖路远，不知何时方能再聆教益。”
玄机老人微微一笑，那笑容里有些许释然，也有几分深意：“有缘自会相见。倒是老朽有一事不明，久欲求证。”
“老朽早年游历时，曾听闻江湖上有一种叫‘酥骨散’的迷药，”玄机老人慢条斯理地说着，目光却似无意地扫过上官复的双手，“据说人若误服，一个时辰内便会周身酸软，功力尽失，任人宰割。不知此物，是否真如传言中那般厉害？”
上官复脸色微不可察地变了一瞬，旋即恢复如常，淡然道：“江湖谣传，多半夸大其词。便是真有此物，也不过是下三滥的手段，登不得大雅之堂。”
“哦？原来只是谣传。”玄机老人抚须点头，仿佛真的只是随口一问，“那老朽便放心了。天色已晚，上官帮主不妨在此多坐片刻，这壶普洱是十年的陈香，暖胃驱寒，莫要辜负了。”说罢，他朝门外的小童招了招手。
“老先生慢走，上官复不便远送了。”上官复拱手，重新坐下，端起那只温热的茶杯，一饮而尽。茶水温润，带着陈香，滑过喉咙，稍稍驱散了心头的寒意。
门吱呀一声关上，屋内重归寂静，只留下上官复一人。烛火将他宽阔的背影投在墙上，拉得长长的，显得有些孤寂。他坐在那里，一动不动，像一尊石雕，脑海中却是惊涛骇浪。苦禅大师、绝代一剑、先祖的耻辱……无数线索纠缠在一起，指向一个他既渴望又恐惧的答案。
玄机老人撑开一把油纸伞，遮住了一老一少。小童提着灯笼，忽地仰头问道：“爷爷，您为何突然问他酥骨散的事？难道那茶里……”
“傻孩子，”玄机老人抚去胡须上的雨珠，眼中闪过一丝狡黠，“上官复何等人物？一代枭雄，心机深沉。若我直言拒绝，或让他觉得有机可乘，恐难善了。我偏要问他，他便知我已防备。即便他真有异动，也要掂量掂量，我是否早已在茶中做了手脚。”
小童恍然大悟，噗嗤笑道：“怪不得他不敢起身送我们，就那样僵坐着！原来是怕一动真气，便露了馅，让人看出他功力未失，哈哈！”
玄机老人也莞尔一笑，牵紧小童的手，步入漆黑的雨幕。两人的身影很快便消融在无边的夜色里，仿佛从未出现过。
而茶馆之内，上官复依旧端坐。许久，他才缓缓吐出一口浊气，低头看了看自己的手掌，又望向杯中残留的茶渣，眼神复杂难明。是福是祸，是真是假，这杯茶，终究成了他心头挥之不去的谜。

> Chapter 12 The White Bone Scripture (Page 1)
The sound of rain has not stopped, and the water dripping from the eaves is like broken pearls, knocking on the bluestone steps, shattering into a void.
Old Man Xuanji tapped his fingertips on the table. The sound was very light, but it seemed to hit Shangguan Fu's heart. The old man's cloudy eyes reflected the candlelight, and he said quietly: "Senior Dongfang converted to Buddhism in his later years and often practiced Zen at Huiquan Temple in Guanmen Mountain. He entrusted the sword intention of the 'unparalleled sword' to Zen Master Honghai, the abbot at the time. Since then, this sword is no longer a killing technique, but has become a Zen technique, which is guarded by successive abbots of Huiquan Temple and is kept secret."
He paused, his eyes as clear as an ancient well: "It has been passed down to this generation that the abbot of Huiquan Temple is Master Kuchan."
"Master Kuchan..." Shangguan Fu's heart skipped a beat, as if he had been struck by lightning. This name is like a rusty key, suddenly opening a dusty secret door deep in the memory. A figure flashed in his mind - the ascetic who always swept the courtyard silently and occasionally went to beg for alms outside the Changle Gang's main altar. He always thought that he was just an ordinary wandering monk, but he never thought that he was actually the sword guard guarding the nightmare of two hundred years ago!
Old Man Xuanji saw Shangguan Fu's gaffe in full view, but said no more. He stood up slowly and brushed his broad sleeves across the table: "That's all the old man said. The leader of the Shangguan Gang has the power to penetrate the heavens and the earth, and he must be able to deduce a few things."
Shangguan Fu also stood up, clasped his fists and said in a deep voice: "Thank you, old gentleman, for your guidance today. At this point, the agreement between you and me has been successfully concluded." There was a trace of unnoticeable regret in his words, "It's just this time of separation, and we have a long way to go. I don't know when I can learn from you again."
The old man Xuanji smiled slightly, and there was some relief in that smile, but also some profound meaning: "We will meet each other if we are destined. But there is something that I don't understand, and I have been wanting to find out for a long time."
"When I was traveling in my early years, I heard that there was a kind of drug called 'Sugu Powder' in the Jianghu," the old man Xuanji said slowly, but his eyes glanced at Shangguan Fu's hands as if unintentionally. "It is said that if a person takes it by mistake, his whole body will become weak within an hour, his power will be lost, and he will be slaughtered. I wonder if this drug is really as powerful as the rumors say?"
Shangguan Fu's face changed imperceptibly for a moment, then returned to normal, and said calmly: "The rumors in the world are mostly exaggerated. Even if there is such a thing, it is just a dirty trick and cannot be considered elegant."
"Oh? It turns out it's just a rumor." The old man Xuanji stroked his beard and nodded, as if it was really just a casual question, "The old man is relieved. It's getting late, Shangguan Gang Leader might as well sit here for a while. This pot of Pu'er is made with ten years of fragrance. It warms the stomach and dispels the cold. Don't let it down." After that, he waved to the child outside the door.
"Old sir, go slowly. It's inconvenient for Shangguan Fu to send him far away." Shangguan Fu cupped his hands, sat down again, picked up the warm tea cup, and drank it all in one gulp. The tea was warm and fragrant, sliding down the throat, slightly dispelling the chill in his heart.
The door creaked shut and silence returned to the room, leaving only Shangguan Fu alone. The candlelight cast his broad back on the wall, stretching it out and making him look a little lonely. He sat there, motionless, like a stone sculpture, but there was a storm in his mind. The master of bitter Zen, the peerless sword, the shame of his ancestors... countless clues are intertwined, pointing to an answer that he both longs for and fears.
The old man Xuanji opened an oil-paper umbrella to cover the old man and the young man. The boy held the lantern and suddenly raised his head and asked: "Grandpa, why did you suddenly ask him about Su Gu San? Could it be that in that tea..."
"Silly boy," the old man Xuanji stroked away the raindrops on his beard, a hint of cunning flashed in his eyes, "What kind of person is Shangguan? He is a powerful man with a deep scheming mind. If I refuse outright, or let him think there is an opportunity, it will be difficult for me to do well. I preferIf you ask him, he will know that I am on guard. Even if he does make any changes, he still has to consider whether I have tampered with the tea. "
The child suddenly realized it and chuckled: "No wonder he didn't dare to get up to see us off, he just sat there frozen like that! It turns out that he was afraid that if he used his true energy, his secret would be exposed and others would see that he had not lost his skills, haha! "
The old man Xuanji also smiled, held the child's hand tightly, and stepped into the dark rain curtain. The figures of the two people quickly disappeared into the endless night, as if they had never appeared before.
In the teahouse, Shangguan Fu was still sitting upright. After a long time, he slowly exhaled a breath, looked down at his palms, and then at the remaining tea residue in the cup, his eyes complicated and unclear. Whether it was a blessing or a curse, true or false, this cup of tea eventually became a lingering mystery in his mind.
